question.en: Discuss the significance of the Banking Ombudsman Scheme in enhancing consumer protection in the Indian financial sector.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Banking Ombudsman Scheme in enhancing consumer protection in the Indian financial sector.

modelAnswer.en: The Banking Ombudsman provides a cost-effective, speedy, and accessible grievance redressal mechanism. It builds trust in the banking system, ensures accountability of banks, and reduces the burden on the judiciary. It is a critical component of financial inclusion and consumer empowerment.
